name: Siamese Asset Public Company Limited
summary: Siamese Asset Public Company Limited engages in the real estate development business in Thailand. The company operates through Property Development, Service, and Hotel, Rental, and Other segments. It develops, manages, and sells residential real estate projects, which include single houses, condominiums, and townhouses. The company also offers consulting and management; juristic person management; health and services; space and kitchen equipment and real estate rental; and hotel management services, as well as operates training center.
